question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20 days, 30 days and 60 days respectively. If A works daily and on every third day B and C also work with A, then in how many days, will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given : **

A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20 days, 30 days and 60 days respectively.

A works daily and on every third day B and C also work with A.

**Formula Used : **

Work done = time × efficiency

**Calculation :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb294fae265f634fda3642ec99555fcc36a69a20c912b59ca8ee9f933d7284f5.png] 

A works daily and on every third day B and C also work with A.

So In 3 days 12 units of work will be done.

And in 15 days 60 units of work will be done.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**
